title: Bevel offset on a glass bench
label: Optical bench: a clear glass pane under a graduated column and top arm, a comb of 22 hairline fibres before a quarter-round bevel; shoulder fibres bend and fan across a ruled strip, and the rim ray runs to a slider on the ruler.
caption: A bevel bends light, so each rim pixel reads from further out: fibres over the flat drop straight, fibres over the shoulder fan away, and raising the IOR slides the rim ray's carriage further along the ruler.
